rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The editorial of BJP Today for July 16-31, 2002 says of 'The elevation of Shri Venkaiah Naidu' as president that 'he took over from Shri Jana Krishnamurthi on July 1, his 53rd birth anniversary as the president', and that the only announcement he made that day appointed Shri Arun Jaitley as the party spokesman.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same sentence names Shri Jana Krishnamurthi as the president from whom Naidu took over on July 1.
